###


List of Genshin Impact Characters


#


As of September 2026, *Genshin Impact* has roughly[~120 playable characters](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Character/List) , including the Traveler,[Aether](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/aether-kqhnrjjj8xl0) or[Lumine](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/lumine-0uhjxtajmbb5) , who can switch elements depending on the region. You play as the **[Traveler](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Traveler)** , searching Teyvat’s seven nations for a twin sibling separated from you on arrival. Each nation is tied to one element and watched over by its own Archon, with the main quest opening up nation by nation, most recently **Snezhnaya** .


Most Genshin Impact characters are built around three fixed things: one of **Teyvat’s seven nations** , an element or ***Vision*** , and a ***weapon*** type: sword, claymore, polearm, bow, or catalyst. From there, personality and backstory usually tie back into whatever that nation’s current story arc is about. ##


Genshin OC Maker & Character Creator: How to Make Your Own Genshin OC


#


A Genshin-style OC is an **original character** designed to fit the world of Teyvat. They aren’t a recolor of an existing playable character. Here’s a simple way to build one:


1. **Pick a nation.** Choose the region your OC is from (for example Mondstadt, Liyue, Inazuma, Sumeru, Fontaine or Natlan). Let its culture shape their outfit, name and values.
2. **Choose an element.** Anemo, Geo, Electro, Dendro, Hydro, Pyro or Cryo. Match it to their personality: a restless OC might be Anemo, a stubborn one Geo.
3. **Choose a weapon type.** Sword, claymore, polearm, bow or catalyst. The weapon says a lot about how they fight and carry themselves.
4. **Design a silhouette and palette.** Use two or three main colors that hint at their element, plus one accent detail such as a charm, a sash or a hair ornament.
5. **Write a hook, a flaw and a goal.** For example: “a cheerful Liyue tea merchant who is secretly terrible with money and wants to open a teahouse in every nation.”
6. **Give them relationships** with your other OCs: a rival, a mentor, someone they owe a favor.


Need more help with the basics? Read our step-by-step guide on[how to make an OC](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/how-to-make-an-oc) , or roll a starting idea with the[OC ideas generator](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/oc-ideas-generator) .

FAQ


#


###


What’s the main story of Genshin Impact, and what’s the most popular fan theory?


#


The[main plot of Genshin Impact](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Genshin_Impact) follows an interstellar Traveler (player) searching for their lost twin, separated on arrival in Teyvat, a world of seven nations, each ruled by an elemental god called an *Archon* . The current arc centers on **Snezhnaya** and the Tsaritsa, the Cryo Archon behind the Fatui. One of the fandom’s most popular theories holds that Celestia’s Heavenly Principles, not the Tsaritsa herself, are the real force behind everything that’s happened.


###


Can I collect all Genshin Impact characters?


#


**Practically, no.** New characters come only through the gacha system – Wishing on limited-time banners, or through specific story quests and events, so pulling every one would take enormous luck or real-world money.
